WITH regional_category_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM total_amount)::NUMERIC / 1000000000), 2) as total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM total_amount)::NUMERIC / 1000000000) DESC) as revenue_rank
  FROM gold_sales_by_category_region
  WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND category IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY region, category
)
SELECT 
  region,
  category,
  total_revenue,
  revenue_rank,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_revenue / SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 2) as pct_of_region
FROM regional_category_sales
ORDER BY region, revenue_rank

WITH normalized_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(category) IN ('electronics', 'electronic', 'elec.', 'electronics') THEN 'Electronics'
      WHEN LOWER(category) IN ('apparel', 'clothing') THEN 'Apparel & Clothing'
      WHEN LOWER(category) IN ('beauty', 'cosmetics', 'beauty') THEN 'Beauty & Cosmetics'
      WHEN LOWER(category) IN ('sports', 'sport', 'sporting goods') THEN 'Sports & Outdoor'
      WHEN LOWER(category) IN ('home', 'home & kitchen', 'home&kitchen') THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
